The dashboard is the box\'s REST API core (dash-node) — a small Node service on 127.0.0.1:4000, fronted by nginx and supervised by pdsm. It powers every in-app library action: browsing and downloading Books, adding and deleting Wikipedia and ZIM content, Kolibri sessions, Maps, and system status. Unlike the content modules, it isn\'t something you install or remove — it ships with the box and is always present. When a newer build is available you can rebuild it in place.
Books, Wikipedia/ZIM, Kolibri and Maps REST endpoints; the nginx vhost; and system version + rebuild endpoints — all served on 127.0.0.1:4000.
